   a. General. Fading might occur on a path            EFFECTIVE TRANSMITTING ANTENNA HEIGHT/ (FEET)
with multipath signals because these signals                Figure 49. Space diversity nomograph.
may reach the antenna out of phase and thus
cancel each other. To overcome fading, use two
receiving antennas located so that when cancel-

lation is likely to occur at one antenna, it is

unlikely to occur at the other. An adequate
signal exists at one or the other of these an-
tennas at all times. Radio Set AN/TRC-29
automatically selects the best signal when it is
connected for diversity operation.
